mapper.insert: insert into abr_lead_card (lead_id, card_status, basics, ai_content, input_digest, ai_call_id, ai_status, error_msg, trigger_type, generated_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{leadId}, #{cardStatus}, cast(#{basics} as jsonb), cast(#{aiContent} as jsonb), coalesce(#{inputDigest}, ''), #{aiCallId}, coalesce(#{aiStatus}, ''), coalesce(#{errorMsg}, ''), coalesce(#{triggerType}, ''), now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now()) on conflict (lead_id) do update set card_status = excluded.card_status, basics = excluded.basics, ai_content = excluded.ai_content, input_digest = excluded.input_digest, ai_call_id = excluded.ai_call_id, ai_status = excluded.ai_status, error_msg = excluded.error_msg, trigger_type = excluded.trigger_type, generated_time = now(), update_by = excluded.update_by, update_time = now()
mapper.select: select r.reach_count as "reach", r.match_count as "match", r.safety_count as "safety", r.needs_improvement_count as "needsImprovement", cast(r.programs as text) as "programs" from abr_assessment_result r join abr_assessment a on a.assessment_id = r.assessment_id where a.visitor_id = #{visitorId} order by r.result_id desc limit 1

select undergrad_tier as "undergradTier", gpa_percent as "gpa", english_status as "englishStatus", ielts_equiv_total as "ieltsTotal", ielts_equiv_min_sub as "ieltsMinSub", target_degree as "degree", target_field as "field", target_countries as "countries", months_to_intake as "monthsToIntake" from abr_profile where visitor_id = #{visitorId} order by profile_id desc limit 1

select s.school_name as "school", p.program_name as "program" from abr_plan_item i join abr_program p on p.program_id = i.program_id join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id where i.visitor_id = #{visitorId} order by i.plan_item_id limit 8
select tool as "tool", count(*) as "count" from abr_tool_run where visitor_id = #{visitorId} group by tool order by tool
select distinct coalesce(payload ->> 'moment', dedup_key) from abr_event where event_type = 'plan_moment' and visitor_id = #{visitorId}
select p.program_id as "programId", s.school_name as "school", p.program_name as "program" from abr_program p join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id where p.program_id in #{id}
